subject: Re: Cell Mixer kickoff — ground-truth scRNA-seq benchmarks
body:
Decisions from today's checkpoint:

1) Ondrej confirmed the mito-filter bias on CD14+ monocytes is real but small (label purity 97.2% vs 99.1% elsewhere). We keep the population in v1 but flag it in the benchmark card. No scope cut.

2) v1 ships with three canonical mixture presets (balanced, rare-population, doublet-heavy) plus the QC-defaults doc. Custom mixtures stay a power-user path.

3) Wanjiru starts Evalline integration next week; internal release target Jul 15, which keeps us inside our window with a few days' buffer.

This also lines up with the Q3 OKRs we locked on June 26 — the benchmark-adoption KR references Cell Mixer explicitly, so the July date matters.

Viktor
